data.group_definition: feature-vector hash, not astronomical source identity
data.descriptor_caveat: Original column positions and ARFF names retained; Readme descriptor-order discrepancy limits physical interpretation.
data.historical_predictions_reused_scope: The inherited false flag describes original A3 production, which did not reuse earlier pilot predictions; this new secondary comparison reuses delivered A3 traditional predictions as explicitly declared in pairing.

selector.k_policy: Original features with native p_value < 0.01; report actual k without top-4 truncation or padding
selector.completion_policy: Persist final power requirement and total iterations. No significant features is a native terminal outcome. If significant features remain with required iterations exceeding performed iterations when recursion or resource cap stops, mark incomplete_native_power_requirement and do not report a completed native selector.

statistical_validity.warnings: Any power-solver ConvergenceWarning, RuntimeWarning, nonfinite output or invalid p/power outside [0,1] fails the gate; retain raw native output without repair.
statistical_validity.no_significant_features: Native no-feature terminal outcome only if statistics remain valid; zero stored power for untested nonsignificant features is expected.

internal_model.seed: native per-iteration random_seed assigned by official wrapper
internal_model.preprocessing: No fitted encoder for native numeric tree selector; input finite-value and dimensional checks only
internal_model.choice_basis: Fixed prospective CatBoost arm of the native library; not selected or tuned against existing outer-test results
internal_model.effective_params: Persist and verify all effective parameters after native copy/set_params against the frozen model and expected iteration seed. Reject unexpected fit kwargs or groups.

native_data_rules.row_order: Frozen outer-training row order, persist exact row identities
native_data_rules.holdout: Native val_size 0.2, stratify false, cv null; sort native split indices as official wrapper does
native_data_rules.seed_behavior: Preserve native random-feature/model cumulative iteration seeds starting at 0; preserve native local-batch-index holdout seeds. Persist both sequences and row hashes. Do not replace with a newly chosen random seed.

handoff.format: Canonical UTF-8 JSON, no pickled native objects
handoff.validation: Persist exclusively and hash before any outer-test evaluation. Verify original index range0..7, ascending unique indices, name/index match, current fold/train/data/split/source identity and passed native completion. LR process reloads bound data itself; selector receives training only.

config.seed: seed(outer_fold, final_model), identical across all seven arms

downstream.encoder: Convert selected outer-training numeric columns to float; require finite nonempty input; center=mean(axis=0), scale=std(axis=0,ddof=0), replace exactly-zero scale with1; transform=(X-center)/scale. No median or imputation. Fit only this fold's selected training columns.
downstream.empty_selection: p=outer-training positive prevalence; no encoder or classifier fit; audit prevalence independently; never pad
downstream.nonempty_fit_counts: One fresh encoder and one common LR per main/replay/audit fold
downstream.frozen_source_reuse: Read-only import or exact hashed source binding; new variable-k adapter; do not modify seven-arm fixed-k final_evaluate

pairing.endpoint: ASSS111 minus native variable-k F1 by fold, plus arithmetic mean of five paired contrasts
secondary: selection, final fit, prediction, audit and archive costs
pairing.comparators: Current delivered A3 traditional seven-arm predictions only, bound by dataset, row IDs, fold, learner config, final seeds and source hashes; do not use earlier pilot/COMPAS outputs
pairing.statistics: Descriptive folds and unweighted mean only; no inferential p-value, CI or equivalence claim. Native p-values belong to selector, not prediction comparison. For F1 signs compute exact fractions from confusion counts. Report partial/failing folds without complete-case five-fold claims.
pairing.loss_line_role: Descriptive reference only; not equivalence or noninferiority margin
pairing.provenance_requirement: Bind every reused final result and prediction artifact to an immutable delivery/execution manifest, dataset hash, heldout row IDs and order, labels, fold, LR configuration and final seed; independently reconstruct paired metrics from bound labels and probabilities before comparison.

verification.raw_native: Independent reconstruction of every saved raw SHAP array, native float32 conversion/aggregation order, p/effect/power/required-iterations, selected set, per-iteration rows/seeds/model parameters and ledger; no tolerance relaxation
verification.cold_replay: Fresh independent process, caches and output roots for full formal fold0 selector plus common LR; no reuse of yesterday probe or native fitted objects; compare selections, raw arrays, stats, row identities, probabilities and seeds
verification.direct_refits: One independent common-LR + encoder refit for each nonempty main fold; for empty branch independently reconstruct training prevalence with0 fits

independent F1 ROC-AUC and AP against stored metrics
downstream_tolerances.model_serialization_rule: Compare checked semantic state, not pickle/joblib byte equality; immutable stored artifact bytes remain hash protected.

verification.resume: Cache-only zero-new-operation invocation; before/after all payload hashes and ledger unchanged
verification.failure_preservation: Keep original training gate float32-audit failure; prospective new auditor may correctly implement native semantics, with new version and no-fit fixtures
delivery: all five fold endpoints or explicit partial failure status
